usage_error.next_action: Fix the call from the message.

config_error.next_action: Fix lab.env / vms.tfvars; ask the user if unclear.

unknown_vm.next_action: Use one of the listed names.

secrets_missing.next_action: Find an existing file by variable names only; else the user runs ./lab account.

vmrest_auth.next_action: The user corrects credentials or runs ./lab account.

needs_user.next_action: Hand the user the command requiring their terminal, sudo or elevated PowerShell.

lock_held.next_action: Wait and retry; never delete the lock.

vmrest_unreachable.next_action: Precheck only: ask the user to start vmrest and retry.

plan_destroy_refused.next_action: Review the VM list; ask the user before --allow-destroy / --confirm.

config_change_requires_off.next_action: Revert configuration edits, down the VM, then restore edits and up.

lan_vnet_mismatch.next_action: Show desired and actual wiring; ask the user about offline VMX repair.

vm_power_unknown.next_action: Run ./lab status; report; no automatic repair.

guest_not_ready.next_action: Read the per-VM reason and reference/pitfalls.md; no automatic retry.

runtime_error.next_action: Read stderr and ./lab status; ask the user about partly changed distributed systems.

envelope.ok: true exactly when error is null
